data.one_liner: Convert between Hijri (Umm al‑Qura) and Gregorian dates with locale support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a HijriCalendar class to create, format, compare, and validate Hijri dates. Allows switching and adding locales for Arabic and English representations. Includes conversion methods to and from Gregorian DateTime objects.
use_when: You need to display or compute Islamic (Hijri) dates in a Flutter/Dart app
You require locale‑aware month and day names for Hijri calendar
avoid_when: You need a full calendar UI widget (this package only provides data conversion)
You require time‑zone aware or astronomical Hijri calculations beyond the Umm al‑Qura table
strengths: Simple API for common Hijri‑Gregorian conversions
Supports adding custom locales and validates them
Null‑safety and works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: No built‑in UI components for date picking
Limited to the Umm al‑Qura calendar; not suitable for other Hijri calculation methods
